title: Horizon Dreams
description: This modpack delivers stunning visuals and immersive generation true to Vanilla Minecraft.
body:
# 💫 A Stunning Visual Overhaul for Vanilla Minecraft
![HD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c534c1305a6d38e0810eaa686ea5e0d483c9413.jpeg)
## 🌍 What This Modpack Offers:

- ✨ Beautiful, immersive visuals with shaders, lighting, and biome-based fog
- 🌅 Stunning Overworld, Nether, and End improvements for richer scenery
- 🌊 Enhanced villages, caves, and environments with atmospheric effects
- 🔊 Enhanced sound effects: Improved environmental sounds, footsteps, and realistic in-game audio.
- 🧭 Minimap & waypoints for smooth and easy navigation
- 🖥️ Clean, modern GUI & HUD enhancements
- 🎙️ Built-in voice chat support for multiplayer
- 🌄 **Full** shader support for Minecraft 1.21.1 for maximum visual quality
  
## 🎬 Heavy animation upgrades:

- First-person & player animations
- Mob & spawn animations
- Eating, movement, and interaction animations

## ✨ Visual polish everywhere:

- Particles, lighting, and subtle effects
- Day & night atmosphere improvements
- A more alive, vibrant world

![HD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfe2bccd6dbee40acc46a80474d8087e4087d455.jpeg)
## ⚙️ Performance-focused:

- 50+ Quality-of-Life mods
- 20+ performance mods
- **Carefully** optimized for smooth FPS even with heavy visuals

## 🖥️ Performance & Requirements

This modpack is visually intensive but highly optimized.

**Recommended**: RTX 3050 Ti (or equivalent) + 8GB RAM
Suggested settings: Render Distance 12 or lower

Built to deliver **maximum visuals** with stable performance, so you can enjoy a beautiful world without unnecessary lag.
